classes.name: ACharacter
classes.comment: Speaking audio character (ACharacter(char *)), derived from ABaseSound (0xc0; PS2 0xb0 with its vptr last at +0xac, reused by ACharacter). Size 0xd0 from deleting dtor 1c110 / GetACharacter alloc 0xd0; +0xc4..+0xcf presumably alignment padding (ABaseSound is 16-byte aligned). Ctor overrides minDistance 3.0, maxDistance 25.0, maxDistanceSq 625.0 (Xbox +0x6c/70/74 = PS2 +0x5c/60/64).

fields.name: voice
fields.evidence: ctor 1c0c0 zeroes [ESI+0xc0] after ABaseSound ctor 1bfa0; GetName 11dd00 builds the name from [voice+4]/[voice+8] or returns default string 0x1911bc; Say/Play pass it to AVoice::Play; ~ACharacter reads it; PS2 +0xb0 (ctor, GetName, IsTalking, Play, Say, dtor). Type AVoice * (no layout yet)

classes.name: AnimationController
classes.comment: Animation controller wrapping an ActPoser (PS2 ctor(ActAnimGroup *, ActPoser *, ?)). Xbox vtable 2 slots (restored by ~AnimationController 12610; its ctors are inlined into subclasses, no other xref to the vtable). Size low confidence: PS2 base is 0x18 (vptr last at +0x14) and Xbox needs at least 0x18. The 48/64-byte allocations under its tag are presumably subclasses. The Xbox member order differs from PS2 (poser at +0x14, PS2 +0x4); the other members are not located on Xbox.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: ~AnimationController 12610 stores 0x189e04 at [ECX]; PS2 vptr LAST at +0x14 (ctor 107338 sw v0,0x14(a0))

fields.name: poser
fields.evidence: GetCurrentFrame 11020 = [[+0x14]+8] (ActPoser.currentFrame); GetRemainingTime 11060 = totalFrames(+0x18)*secondsPerFrame(+0x2c) - secondsPerFrame*currentFrame; PS2 accessors and GetActPoser read +0x4 (ctor a2 = ActPoser *), pointee offsets +4 on PS2 as in the ActPoser layout

notes: AIElementController: no vptr and an identical Xbox/PS2 layout. Construct 285b0 allocates 0x58 and stores the object in fObj (0x1ddee4). The UData lookups at string 0x18b7b8/0x18b7a4/0x18b790 (defaults 0x20/6/0x10) fill +0x0/+0x4/+0x8; names there are guesses (reading those strings would settle them).
AIElementController element records are 0x100 bytes (CARP::AIElement copies) and AIElementTracking is 0x50 bytes; neither type is in Ghidra, so the arrays are typed void *.

AnimationController: Xbox and PS2 member order differ; the ActPoser pointer is at Xbox +0x14 vs PS2 +0x4 (PS2 +0x14 is the vptr). Size 0x18 is a lower bound from PS2. GetTotalFrames 11030 not checked (no return given). GetCurrentTime/GetTotalTime float returns inferred from PS2 GetRemainingTime subtracting their f0 results.

AICharacterEnemySSnow::GetVehiclePtr 1fd30 sits just before AICharacterEnemySnow's ctor 1fd40: likely a COMDAT-folded accessor shared with EnemySnow (both keep the vehicle at +0x140). Likewise AICharacterEnemyDriver::GetRotPos 20e30 (called by Driver HandleInterrupts as (this, MATRIX4 &)) lies in the EnemySSnow address range and may be folded code shared among subclasses.

ACharacter was a bare 0xd0 placeholder: its base is ABaseSound (ctor 1c0c0 calls ABaseSound ctor 1bfa0), and its only own field is voice (+0xc0). The +0x6c/+0x70/+0x74/+0x7c/+0x94 accesses in the evidence are ABaseSound members (min/max distance, volume, mix).
Ghidra calls: 21 (10 + 9 + 2 in three python runs).
